cards.altText: A tree is a hypothesis about relationships. PHYLOGENETICS Read the evidence behind the branches. A three-tip conceptual paper branching tree with no support values; small conceptual tree label.
cards.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Make ONE finished Instagram carousel card, SQUARE 1:1 aspect ratio requested 1080x1080. Full bleed with 80px safe margins. ANGSUMI premium editorial identity: ivory #F7F2E8, maroon #6F2437, forest #304939, sage #94A58B, charcoal. Oversized expressive serif headline; clean readable sans-serif supporting text; generous space, compelling tactile three-dimensional paper scientific metaphor. Brand top ANGSUMI; footer @angsumi.online and supplied card number. Use only EXACT supplied headline and body and explicitly requested tiny conceptual label. No extra handwritten notes, slogans, equations, percentages, fake data, graph values, invented accession IDs or watermarks. Conceptual teaching illustrations, never pretend these are actual analysis results. No collage of several cards: one square card only. Topic phylogenetics. Branching archive: precise sculptural tree made of paper branches, sequence folios, maroon and forest on ivory. Trees have three abstract tips A B C, no taxonomy or invented support values. Card 1/6. about relationships.". Body exact: "PHYLOGENETICS
Read the evidence behind the branches.". Visual: A three-tip conceptual paper branching tree with no support values; small conceptual tree label.. Footer number "1/6".
